name: study4_cohort
title: Cardiology Outpatient Visits of Patients with Non-Ischemic Dilated Cardiomyopathy
description: This cohort includes cardiology out-patient clinic visits of adult patients (age >= 18 years at the time of the visit) with a non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy diagnosis (ICD-10 I42.0). A visit is included if it took place at most 2 months before, or any time after, the date I42.0 was first registered for the patient. The I42.0 diagnosis does not need to be recorded in the visit itself. Criteria are applied per visit, so a patient can be included through more than one visit.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

entry.name: patientEncounter
entry.description: Captures cardiology outpatient encounters (ambulatory class) for patients.

eligibility.name: adultDcmCohort
eligibility.description: Selects visits of adult patients (>=18 years at the time of the visit) with a non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy diagnosis (ICD-10 I42.0) first registered no later than 2 months after the visit.

criteria.name: adult
criteria.description: Excludes visits of patients younger than 18 years at the time of the visit.

criteria.name: dcm
criteria.description: Includes visits of patients who have a non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy diagnosis (ICD-10 I42.0) registered at any time up to 2 months after the start of the visit, i.e. visits from 2 months before the first I42.0 registration onwards.

period.description: Includes all eligible cardiology outpatient visits for the defined cohort population.
